verdict.rationale: gstack ships skill-creation mechanisms, but they are narrow. /skillify codifies a repeated /scrape intent into a reusable script (gstack-docs-9). Domain-skills let the agent save per-site skill notes and promote a per-project skill to global (gstack-docs-10, gstack-docs-11, gstack-docs-26). Dev mode symlinks a checkout so Claude Code reads skills directly while you author them (gstack-docs-16). None of this is a general meta-skill that guides an agent through writing, improving, and packaging arbitrary new skills. Missing for 10: a general-purpose skill-authoring meta-skill, guided improvement or iteration of existing skills, a packaging or distribution workflow beyond project-to-global promotion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
